headline: Strategic Base Shifts Stall Amid Grinding Frontline Attrition
war_summary: Frontline base captures ground to a complete standstill across all sectors over the past two hours, halting the territorial exchanges recorded earlier in Farranac Coast, Lykos Isle, and Oarbreaker. Despite the temporary pause in structural turnovers, combat intensity remains punishingly severe along several contested fronts. Weathered Expanse bore the brunt of the fighting, tallying over 4,700 combined casualties in two hours while Warden casualty rates peaked above 1,500 an hour. Heavy fighting likewise persisted in Clahstra, where nearly 2,200 casualties were reported in the same period amid elevated Colonial and Warden losses. Steady bloodletting also continues across Linn of Mercy, Dead Lands, and Lykos Isle, even as troop enlistment rates show cooling trends across the wider theatre. The maritime sectors of Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf have settled into quieter watches, while rear logistical regions report negligible hostile contact.
